source: SPM 2026 Trial – Perlis – English Paper 2 · Part 2 · Question 2 · Essay (125–150 words)
paragraphs: In today's image-conscious society, physical appearance is important to some people because first impressions matter. Fairly or not, people often judge others by how they look within seconds. Furthermore, social media has created unrealistic beauty standards. Many teenagers constantly compare themselves with flawless influencers online.

Appearance can affect self-confidence because looking presentable makes a person feel more self-assured. For instance, a student in a neat uniform tends to speak up more confidently in class. However, an obsession with looks can also lead to insecurity. Some people feel anxious whenever they notice a minor flaw.

Firstly, we can maintain our physical appearance by adopting a healthy lifestyle. Eating nutritious food and getting enough sleep keep our skin and body healthy. Secondly, we should practise good personal hygiene and grooming. In a nutshell, true confidence comes from caring for ourselves, not from chasing perfection.
